answer: Cloning identities means re-staking and re-anchoring hardware at each jetty, so an attacker flooding fake participants pays full stake plus attestation cost per sybil, while honest agents amortize one stake across epochs. Each agent must stake a marble token bound to a verified hardware jetty before voting, and the registry tracks a trust delta that decays when behavior diverges from peers. This makes mass reputation slot creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0132 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
